name: Portabase
tagline: Database backup and restore for 10+ engines, self-hosted
description: Portabase is a self-hosted backup and restore tool covering a wide range of database engines: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, SQLite, Redis, Valkey, Firebird, MSSQL and Docker volumes. It centralizes backup scheduling, retention, and one-click restore from a web dashboard, and it can integrate with Portabase agents to manage operations securely. With five installation paths — an automated CLI, Docker, Docker Compose, Unraid Community Apps, and Kubernetes via Helm — it is designed to drop into an existing infrastructure without rewriting how you already run your databases. Because many database systems are unsupported for restore by default, Portabase fills a real operational gap for self-hosters who need reliable, repeatable snapshots of heterogeneous data stores.
highlights: Backup and restore for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, SQLite, Redis, Valkey, Firebird, MSSQL and Docker volumes
Web dashboard for scheduling, retention, and one-click restore
Five install paths: CLI, Docker, Docker Compose, Unraid, and Helm
Optional Portabase agents for secure, managed operations
Apache-2.0 licensed, built on Next.js and Drizzle
curatorNote: Portabase quietly solves one of the least glamorous problems in self-hosting: trustworthy backups across many different database engines. It was spotlighted in VirtualizationHowto's July 2026 roundup and still sits under 2k stars, which is remarkable for a tool this broadly useful.
